banner.title: About our use of cookies
banner.body: We use cookies and similar technologies (pixels, local storage and so on) to keep the site running, analyze visits and improve our service. Necessary cookies are always on; analytics and marketing cookies are only loaded once you have consented. See our
banner.hint: You can click "Customize categories" to review the cookies we actually use, category by category, and you can change or withdraw your consent at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the footer or the floating button.

pref.title: Cookie Preference Center
pref.intro: The cookies actually used on this site are listed below, grouped by purpose. Necessary cookies are required for the site to work and cannot be turned off; the other categories are off by default, and the relevant scripts are loaded only after you turn them on. To find out more, see our
pref.dirtyHint: You have unsaved changes. They will take effect once you click "Save my choices" below.
pref.lastUpdatedHint: Withdrawing consent immediately stops the relevant scripts and deletes cookies already stored on your device.

necessary.name: Necessary (strictly necessary)
necessary.desc: Required for the site to work; cannot be turned off
necessary.intro: These cookies maintain your session, protect against cross-site request forgery and support CDN security checks — they are the foundation of the site's usability.
necessary.legalBasis: Necessary to provide the service; no consent required
necessary.note: Cloudflare cookies are set by our CDN and security provider for security protection only; they are not used for cross-site tracking.

functional.name: Functional and preferences
functional.desc: Remembers language, region and interface settings
functional.intro: These cookies remember the choices you have made (language, region, interface preferences) so you don't have to set them again on every visit.
functional.legalBasis: Consent (Articles 13 and 14 of the Personal Information Protection Law)

analytics.name: Analytics and statistics
analytics.desc: Traffic, time on site, heatmaps and session recordings
analytics.intro: Measures traffic and click distribution to understand which content users interact with most, so we can improve the experience.
analytics.legalBasis: Consent; for the EU also Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR + Section 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive
analytics.note: Since October 2025 Clarity requires a site to send a consent v2 signal before full tracking is enabled. Session recording amounts to systematic behavioral monitoring; for the EU we recommend carrying out a DPIA and enabling content masking.

marketing.name: Advertising and marketing
marketing.desc: Personalized recommendations, conversion attribution, cross-site identifiers
marketing.intro: Set by our advertising partners to build an interest profile and show relevant ads on other sites. They do not directly store personal information, but rely on a unique identifier for your browser and device.
marketing.legalBasis: Separate consent; where personal information is transferred overseas, separate notice and separate consent are required
marketing.note: Data is processed by default in Azure data centers in the US, which constitutes a cross-border transfer of personal information; the recipients and safeguards (SCC / DPF) must be listed separately in the privacy policy.
